IMPORTANT: Do this research YOURSELF by calling WebSearch + WebFetch directly. DO NOT use the Agent tool. DO NOT spawn, launch, or delegate to any sub-agents under any circumstances — you personally run every search and write the report. First load the tools via ToolSearch query "select:WebSearch,WebFetch".

Deep, current (2025-2026) research to add new games to a game-server hosting product (Nxeon).

SCOPE — sandbox/source/misc cluster, 7 games: (1) Factorio (headless server), (2) Garry's Mod (GMod), (3) DayZ, (4) Conan Exiles, (5) Unturned, (6) The Forest & Sons of the Forest, (7) Minecraft Bedrock (distinct from Java).

For EACH game return a structured, buildable section:
- **Self-hostable?** confirm the dedicated/headless server exists.
- **SteamCMD app ID** (or install source: Factorio headless tarball from factorio.com; Bedrock server zip from minecraft.net) + install/update method + start command/binary. Note Linux server availability (DayZ Linux server nuance, etc.).
- **Editions/versions/branches** to offer as options.
- **Mods/gamemodes/content ecosystem** for one-click: Factorio mod portal + headless mod loading; GMod Steam Workshop collections + gamemodes (DarkRP/TTT/Sandbox/Prop Hunt) + addon management; DayZ Steam Workshop mods + maps (Chernarus/Livonia/Namalsk); Conan Exiles mods + Isle of Siptah/Exiled Lands map choice; Unturned Steam Workshop + RocketMod/OpenMod plugins; Bedrock behavior/resource packs + add-ons + cross-play.
- **Key editable config file(s)** + the 8-15 most-tuned settings per game.
- **Resource baseline** (RAM/CPU per player tier).
- **Hosting demand signal** (commonly hosted? rough demand read).
- **Verdict**: recommended default + the 3-5 highest-value options to expose in a deploy wizard.

Unturned is free-to-play (good free-trial funnel); Factorio is very lightweight. Be concrete and itemized with source URLs. Write the FULL report as your final message — do not hand off to anyone.

Based on the search results, here's what I found about Factorio headless server installation on Linux:

## Installation Methods

There are two install paths: the headless tarball from Wube Software (no graphics or sounds, smaller download) and SteamCMD (Steam app 427520, full game files but starts headless when given --start-server flags).

## Headless Tarball Download

Wube Software publishes a Linux headless package at factorio.com/download/headless. Download, extract, run with: `mkdir -p /opt/factorio && cd /opt/factorio && wget https://factorio.com/get-download/stable/headless/linux64 -O factorio_headless.tar.xz && tar -xJvf factorio_headless.tar.xz`

## SteamCMD Option

The SteamCMD option uses Steam app 427520, with full game files but behaves identically as a server when launched with --start-server.

## Key Notes

The headless package does not contain any files irrelevant for a pure server, such as graphics and sounds, and is not linked against libraries that may not be present on a server machine, such as Xlib, libGL or libasound. This option should be selected if running in a 3rd party hosted server.

**Note:** Your search mentioned app ID "2025," but the correct Steam app ID for Factorio is **427520**.

## Installation via SteamCMD

Use SteamCMD with AppID 4020 to install and update your server on Windows or Linux. The basic installation command is:

Type "app_update 4020 validate" and run the command, where 4020 is the game ID for Garry's Mod dedicated servers.

## Gamemodes and Workshop Collections

To set up a Garry's Mod dedicated server, download the server with AppID 4020, create a Steam Game Server Login Token using Garry's Mod AppID 4000, add +sv_setsteamaccount to your startup command, and load Workshop collections with +host_workshop_collection.

Use one valid GSLT per server instance with +sv_setsteamaccount, created with Garry's Mod AppID 4000; servers without GSLT receive a severe server-list ranking penalty.

Use a Workshop collection with +host_workshop_collection - you do not need a Steam Web API key for normal collection pulls.

Based on the search results, here's what I found about DayZ dedicated server setup on Linux with steamcmd app ID 223350:

## Server Installation

App ID 223350 is the DayZ Server depot, which you install using steamcmd with the command: `./steamcmd.sh login YOUR_STEAM_USERNAME force_install_dir ./DayZServer app_update 223350 validate quit`

## Authentication Requirements

Unlike many other dedicated servers, DayZ's SteamCMD depot (app 223350) rejects anonymous login and requires a Steam account that owns DayZ (app 221100) to complete the installation. The same authentication requirement applies to Workshop mod downloads, which use the client app ID 221100.

## Mods and Workshop

To install mods from the workshop on a Linux server, you use steamcmd with the command `workshop_download_item 221100 [MOD_ID]` to download specific workshop mods. Modded DayZ dedicated servers use SteamCMD app 223350 with workshop_download_item commands using mod IDs from app 221100.

## Linux Compatibility

Bohemia Interactive documents Linux hosting directly, and the native ./DayZServer binary runs without Wine or a compatibility layer. The installation covers Linux machines (Ubuntu/Debian) using SteamCMD.

## System Requirements

For Linux: OS should be Ubuntu 20.04/22.04 LTS or Debian 11/12, with 8GB RAM minimum (16GB recommended), and 25GB+ disk space.

## SteamCMD Installation

To download the dedicated server with SteamCMD, use App ID 443030 with the command: steamcmd +login anonymous +app_update 443030 validate +quit

## Isle of Siptah Map Configuration

Edit Engine.ini located in Conan Exiles Dedicated Server\ConanSandbox\Saved\Config\WindowsServer and add: [/Script/EngineSettings.GameMapsSettings] ServerDefaultMap=/Game/DLC_EXT/DLC_Siptah/Maps/DLC_Isle_of_Siptah

Based on the search results, here's comprehensive information about setting up The Forest dedicated server using SteamCMD with app ID 556450:

## Installation Steps

To install The Forest server, open SteamCMD and run: `force_install_dir C:\TheForestServer\` followed by `login anonymous` and `app_update 556450 validate`.

## Installation Process

Use `force_install_dir ./forest_ds/` to create a folder named "forest_ds" where server files will be installed. After logging in anonymously, start the download with `app_update 556450 validate` and type `exit` to close SteamCMD when complete.

## Server Configuration

After installation, locate the Server.cfg file at: `C:\Users\YOUR_USERNAME\AppData\LocalLow\SKS\TheForestDedicatedServer\ds`. There are two ways to configure the server: using command line parameters or the Server.cfg file, with command line parameters overwriting config file entries.

## Running the Server

You can create a .batch file with: `start TheForestDedicatedServer.exe -batchmode -showlogs -treeregrowmode -configfilepath ./server.cfg -savefolderpath ./savefilesserver/`.

## System Requirements & Ports

You need at least 2 GB free disk space, 4 GB RAM, and 2 cores with at least 1.8 GHz. Required ports include TCP 8766, 27015-27030, 27036-27037 and UDP 4380, 8766, 27000-27031, 27036.

## Updates

Check for updates every few weeks using: `force_install_dir C:\TheForestServer\` followed by `login anonymous` and `app_update 556450`.
